content: Implement schema discovery and repository layer for GET /api/users/:id with user_sports JOIN
activeForm: Implementing schema discovery and repository layer for GET /api/users/:id with user_sports JOIN
description: Phase 0: Schema Discovery - Read migrations to validate ID type (integer vs UUID), status field (enum vs boolean), and user_sports table structure. Document findings before proceeding. Phase 1: Implement user.repository.ts with findById method that JOINs users and user_sports tables. Returns complete user profile with sports array. Phase 2: Write 15 MVP-tier tests for repository layer (8 unit tests for findById/getUserWithSports, 5 integration tests for database queries/JOIN performance, 2 edge case tests for null handling/special characters). This is a foundational subtask - controller, route, and E2E tests will be separate subtasks.
